[[File:Card-Back-Dark-Side.png|260px|thumb|right|Dark Side card back.<ref name="drive" />]]

The '''Dark Side''' is one of the two sides in the [[Star Wars CCG]]. One player must play Dark Side cards; the other plays [[Light Side]] cards. Dark Side cards share a black card back with the Imperial crest. Premiere Dark [[Character]]s are [[Imperial]]s, [[Alien]]s, and [[Droid]]s.

Printed English cards are '''63×88 mm''' (Euro poker).<ref name="encyc" />

== Card back ==

Retail Decipher Dark Side backs are black with the Imperial crest and STAR WARS branding. The image is the '''no-text''' high-resolution back from the community MPC print-ready Drive, made for print-and-play, not a retail card.<ref name="drive" /><ref name="reddit" />
